tools.name: brainprint.context
tools.description: Grouped Task 10/11 context operations, selected by `mode`: change (an edit at a target), resume (an explicit WorkItem), rules (current applicable Policy), work_items (by status), lineage (one Policy/Decision's one-hop history), handoffs (a WorkItem's handoff history), structure (grouped structural summary), status (the daemon's own Status -- no fabricated Workspace health score).

ChangeKindParam.description:
explicitly -- the existing closed `ChangeKind` vocabulary, mirrored
field-for-field. No MCP/Agent inference of which one applies. Nested
inside `RelationsParams`, not the tool's root schema, so its own
`#[serde(tag = ...)]` `oneOf` shape is fine (#25's root-`type`
requirement applies only to the top-level tool input).
ChangeKindParam.title: 25 "brainprint.relations": the caller states the change form

DeliveryContinuationParam.description:
Field-for-field mirror of `DeliveryContinuationWire`, so it carries a
real JSON Schema across the MCP boundary without deriving
`schemars::JsonSchema` on the locked Task 11 wire type itself. Every
field round-trips losslessly through `into_wire`/`from_wire`.

GroupingParam.description:
Mirrors `GroupingSpecWire`. Nested inside `ContextParams`, not the
tool's root schema, so its own `#[serde(tag = ...)]` `oneOf` shape is
fine.

oneOf.description:
A public signature changed: everything that calls, overrides,
implements, or names it as a type.
A Symbol is being renamed: every written mention of the name.
A module moved or was renamed: everything that imports it.

A base class or interface changed: the hierarchy under it, and
what names it as a type.

budget_profile.description: Response size per page; not the `mode: text` scan budget.

change.description:
`mode: change` only. Omit for a plain edit with no declared
change form.

continuation.description:
The exact `DeliveryContinuationWire` a previous call returned
under `more_available: true`. Opaque -- echo it back verbatim,
never hand-construct it.

id.description:
`mode: lineage`: required. Canonical UUID string of the Policy or
Decision.

limit.description:
`mode: work_items`: defaults to 50. `mode: handoffs`: defaults to
20.

max_bytes.description: Overrides `budget_profile`'s `max_bytes`; not the text scan budget.

symbol_in_resource.description:
Restricts a Symbol selector to one Resource (canonical UUID
string). Valid only alongside a Symbol selector.

target_json.description:
The complete `ProjectionTargetWire` as JSON -- the only way to
reach a rare `GraphEndpoint` form (External/Domain/Logical).
Mutually exclusive with every field above.

work_item.description:
Canonical UUID string. `mode: resume`/`handoffs`: required.
`mode: change`: optional (the WorkItem this edit belongs to).

workspace_id.description:
An explicit Workspace identity (canonical UUID string), for a
caller that already resolved one.

workspace_path.description:
Absolute path to the Workspace root. Falls back to
`brainprint-mcp`'s startup working directory when neither this
nor `workspace_id` is given.
